title: A moment of reflection
desc: How do you evaluate today's session? Your feedback helps us adapt the app to you.
privacyNotice: When you submit, your answers on this page are sent to a server in the EU together with a randomly generated code, the app version you used, your language, the colour theme and your active comfort settings. They are stored only for the analysis of this master's thesis. Names, contact details and the content of your exercises are not transmitted.
privacyNoticeBlock2Addendum: On this page, this also includes the information about you.
